resources.name: ATKIS Verkehr — native object catalogue (by object type)

terrain.note: WEGA 3D quantized-mesh terrain (Thuringia DGM2). DEAD since TASK_15: it was only ever consumed by the CesiumJS Weimar Model block, which is gone — all four viewports are MapLibre and use the raster-dem `terrainDem` build instead. Kept as a record of the WEGA endpoint; wire it back only if a Cesium/quantized-mesh path returns.

terrainDem.note: Real elevation as a MapLibre raster-dem source — Terrarium-encoded PNG tiles built from the Thuringia DGM1 (1 m airborne-laserscanning DTM, vintage 2014-2019) by tools/build_dgm_terrain.py. Static tiles under web/terrain/weimar-dgm/. Canonical DEM for Grasshopper: data/processed/dgm_weimar/weimar_dgm_25832.tif. TASK 10 — Blue-green Infrastructure; re-added to Weimar Model in TASK 15 (that viewport is MapLibre again, so it uses this raster-dem terrain like Blue-green, not the WEGA quantized-mesh one). Covers 145 of 178 AOI tiles (eastern strip not yet downloaded).

sidebar._doc: Per-viewport semantic grouping of the left panel. A group has a name and an ordered list of items; each item is one sidebar row (one eye toggle) that drives one OR MORE layer ids together. When a viewport has an entry here, the panel and the metadata block under the map are both built from it; viewports with no entry fall back to grouping by source resource. Layer descriptions/sources are NOT shown in the sidebar — they live only in the metadata block.

items.name: Land cover (forest, parks, meadows, cemeteries, allotments, sport)

layers.name: Weimar — Administrative boundary
layers.description: Official city limits of Weimar (kreisfreie Stadt, Gemeinde_ID 55000) from the Thuringia administrative-boundaries WFS (GRENZUEB_wfs, layer th_etrs89utm32_gmd). Single polygon, ~1360 vertices, converted once to a static GeoJSON by tools/fetch_weimar_boundary.py — no runtime WFS dependency. Faint fill + outline.

layers.name: Weimar — Ortsteile & Stadtteile
layers.description: Cadastral-legal subdivision of the city: 14 Ortsteile (the incorporated villages — Tröbsdorf, Gelmeroda, Taubach, Legefeld/Holzdorf, …) plus 5 inner-city Stadtteile (Innenstadt, Nordstadt, Südstadt, …). 19 polygons total. Each carries the district name (ortsteil), its class (art = Ortsteil | Stadtteil), a link to the city page and to the bylaw (Ortsrecht). Converted once from the Stadt Weimar open-data Shapefile ko_wei_ort via tools/fetch_weimar_shp.py — static GeoJSON, no runtime service. Reference border only: thin outline, no fill.
layers.attribution: © GDI-Th / Stadt Weimar, Datenlizenz Deutschland – Namensnennung 2.0

layers.name: Parcels
layers.description: 41 839 cadastral parcels (Flurstücke) for the Weimar AOI — real vector geometry with attributes, not a WMS picture. Parsed once from the 45 Gemarkung GML files of the INSPIRE-ATOMFeed "TH Flurstücke/Grundstücke ALKIS" by tools/fetch_weimar_parcels.py. Attributes: nationalCadastralReference, areaValue_m2, label (parcel number). Plain outline fill — this is a Grasshopper-export-ready parcel layer, not extruded (that's only for buildings).

layers.name: Parcels use
layers.description: Cadastral parcels coloured by ALKIS actual land use (grouped into 14 categories, tools/build_parcels_use.py) and clipped to the Weimar administrative boundary. Attributes as Parcels plus useCategory.

layers.name: Parcels
layers.description: Parcels as white outlines on a transparent fill (Street Section Analysis); same clipped file as Parcels use.

layers.name: ALKIS — Buildings
layers.description: Cadastral building footprints (Gebäude) for all of Thuringia. Polygon outlines with usage-based fill colour. Raster (WMS), no attributes. Only renders at scales larger than ~1:10 000 — zoom in.

layers.name: ALKIS — Parcels
layers.description: Cadastral parcel boundaries (Flurstücke). Polygon outlines only. Raster (WMS), no attributes. Only renders at scales larger than ~1:10 000 — zoom in.

layers.name: ALKIS — Structures & facilities
layers.description: Selected structures and facilities (Bauwerke und Einrichtungen): retaining walls, courtyards, small technical structures, etc. Sparse. Raster (WMS), no attributes. Only renders at scales larger than ~1:10 000.

layers.name: ALKIS — Parcel numbers
layers.description: Parcel number labels (Flurstücksnummern) as text. Raster (WMS). Only renders at very large scales (larger than ~1:2 500).

layers.name: Buildings (footprint, flat)
layers.description: 63 450 building footprints for the Weimar AOI, each with a height attribute (m). Parsed once from the Thuringia LoD2 CityGML by tools/parse_citygml_footprints.py. Flat 2D render — see "Buildings (3D)" for the same source extruded by height. Large file (~23 MB), off by default.

layers.name: Building footprints
layers.description: 63 450 flat building outlines (no height/volume) for Grasshopper: usage, height, floors, buildingId plus area (m²) and areaSource. Built from weimar_buildings_footprint_height.geojson by tools/build_building_footprints.py; area is computed in EPSG:25832 (ALKIS WFS has no official building area). Off by default.

layers.name: Buildings (3D)
layers.description: Same 63 450 building footprints as "Buildings (footprint, flat)" — shares the identical GeoJSON source (fetched once, not duplicated) — rendered as fill-extrusion volumes using the parsed measuredHeight/Z-range attribute (fill-extrusion-height = height, base 0). Neutral semi-transparent wall colour, no roof shape or texture — just a readable massing volume. Toggle this on instead of (or alongside) the flat render for a 3D read of the city fabric.

layers.name: Buildings 3D - Heights without roofs
layers.description: Building boxes extruded to the eave (wall top), without the roof volume. Per Building/BuildingPart from the CityGML LoD2 roof surfaces (tools/build_buildings_eave_height.py): area-weighted mean of the lowest edge of each pitched roof surface / the height of each flat one, relative to the lowest ground vertex. Flat roofs keep their full height. Attributes: eaveHeight (= height), ridgeHeight, roofType, heightWithAttic / atticFloorLikely (ALKIS floors that do not fit under the eave), usage, floors. Off by default.

layers.name: Building use footprints
layers.description: Flat building outlines coloured by useCategory (18 categories, mapping in tools/building_use_categories.json, baked into the GeoJSON by tools/bake_building_use.py). Same source file as Building footprints. 3DM export: parent Rhino layer 'Footprints by use' with one child layer per category. Off by default.

layers.name: Building use 3D
layers.description: 3D building volumes (height extrusion) coloured by useCategory; same source file as Buildings (3D). 3DM export: parent Rhino layer '3D buildings by use' with one child layer per category. Off by default.

layers.name: Car network (Space Syntax)
layers.description: Space Syntax car network, drawn by hand in QGIS (TASK_35) — her drawing is the source of truth, nothing simplified/straightened/thinned. Topology-noded (ends snapped, real crossings split into graph nodes), joined to pedestrian at identical shared vertices, clipped to Base border (city centre only). Presets from TASK_31-34 stay on disk, unused. Off by default.

layers.name: Pedestrian network (Space Syntax)
layers.description: Space Syntax pedestrian network, drawn by hand in QGIS (TASK_35) — her drawing is the source of truth, nothing simplified/straightened/thinned. Topology-noded, every end near car snapped exactly onto it (car gets the same vertex, never split unless SPLIT_CAR_AT_JUNCTIONS), clipped to Base border (city centre only). Presets from TASK_31-34 stay on disk, unused. Off by default.

layers.name: Pedestrian network

layers.name: DOP — Colour 20 cm
layers.description: Digital orthophoto, true-colour RGB, 20 cm ground resolution. The primary aerial base image — renders at all working zoom levels. Opaque raster (WMS, JPEG).

layers.name: DOP — Colour-infrared 20 cm
layers.description: Digital orthophoto, colour-infrared (CIR: near-IR / red / green), 20 cm resolution. Vegetation shows red. Renders at all working zoom levels. Opaque raster (WMS, JPEG).

layers.name: DOP — Grayscale 20 cm
layers.description: Digital orthophoto, panchromatic (grayscale), 20 cm resolution. Renders at all working zoom levels. Opaque raster (WMS, JPEG).

layers.name: DOP — Colour 2 m (overview)
layers.description: Digital orthophoto, true-colour RGB, 2 m resolution. Lightweight city/region overview. Only renders when zoomed OUT past ~1:25 000 — it switches off at street level (use the 20 cm layer there). Opaque raster (WMS, JPEG).

layers.name: DOP — Colour-infrared 2 m (overview)
layers.description: Digital orthophoto, colour-infrared, 2 m resolution. Region overview; only renders when zoomed OUT past ~1:25 000. Opaque raster (WMS, JPEG).

layers.name: DOP — Grayscale 2 m (overview)
layers.description: Digital orthophoto, panchromatic (grayscale), 2 m resolution. Region overview; only renders when zoomed OUT past ~1:25 000. Opaque raster (WMS, JPEG).

layers.name: DOP — Image metadata
layers.description: Footprints of the individual orthophoto tiles with acquisition metadata (flight date, sensor, resolution). Semi-transparent overlay, queryable via click. Renders below ~1:750 000.

layers.name: Terrain relief (hillshade)
layers.description: Shaded relief (Schummerung) computed from the 2 m digital terrain model. Grayscale raster picture of the ground surface — high detail (river terraces, embankments, quarries visible). NOT elevation values and NOT 3D terrain geometry: it stays flat, the 3D view is not displaced. Opaque raster (WMS, JPEG). Renders at all zoom levels.

layers.name: DGM5 — Hillshade
layers.description: Shaded relief (Schummerung) computed from the 5 m digital terrain model. Same as DGM2 but coarser and lighter — better for a regional overview. NOT elevation values, NOT 3D terrain geometry. Opaque raster (WMS, JPEG). Renders at all zoom levels.

layers.name: 3D Buildings LoD2 (coloured)
layers.description: LoD2 building models for all of Thuringia — footprint-accurate blocks with standardised roof shapes, roofs coloured by type. Cesium 3D Tiles (b3dm). NOT SHOWN on the web platform: the only engine that rendered these tiles' legacy KHR_techniques_webgl materials was CesiumJS, removed in TASK_15 (the WEGA real-roof path was judged not worth its cost). Real roof geometry for Grasshopper lives in data/processed/wega_buildings_obj/ (TASK_12). No viewport — kept as a manifest record of the WEGA endpoint.

layers.name: 3D Buildings LoD2 (single colour)
layers.description: Same LoD2 building models, one neutral colour — cleaner backdrop for overlaying other data. Cesium 3D Tiles. Requires the local CORS proxy.

layers.name: 3D Structures (Bauwerke)
layers.description: Engineering structures modelled separately from buildings: bridges, tunnels, retaining walls, large technical constructions. Cesium 3D Tiles. NOT SHOWN on the web platform — same reason as "3D Buildings LoD2": the CesiumJS viewport was removed in TASK_15. No viewport; kept as a manifest record of the WEGA endpoint.

layers.name: Bebauungspläne & Satzungen
layers.description: Perimeters (Geltungsbereiche) of Weimar's legally binding development plans and bylaws — 65 plans. Each polygon carries the plan name, type, legal status, authority and a direct link to the plan PDF (click a feature). Converted once from the city's open-data Shapefile by tools/fetch_weimar_bplan.py; static GeoJSON, no runtime service. Perimeters only — not the internal zoning drawing.
layers.attribution: © GDI-Th / Stadt Weimar, Datenlizenz Deutschland – Namensnennung 2.0

layers.name: Schools
layers.description: 29 school locations in Weimar (Grundschule, Regelschule, Gymnasium, Gemeinschaftsschule, Förderschule…). Points with full attributes: name, type, address, phone/e-mail, website, operator (Träger), school authority. From the city open-data Shapefile ko_we_schul via tools/fetch_weimar_shp.py — static GeoJSON. Click a marker for details.
layers.attribution: © GDI-Th / Stadt Weimar, Datenlizenz Deutschland – Namensnennung 2.0

layers.name: Child care (Kitas)
layers.description: 40 child-care / kindergarten locations in Weimar. Points with name, address, operator (Träger), contact. From the city open-data Shapefile ko_we_kita via tools/fetch_weimar_shp.py — static GeoJSON. Click a marker for details.
layers.attribution: © GDI-Th / Stadt Weimar, Datenlizenz Deutschland – Namensnennung 2.0

layers.name: Water & spring protection zones
layers.description: Drinking-water and mineral-spring protection areas (Wasser- und Heilquellenschutzgebiete) with their inner/outer zones. Groundwater protection — Weimar has a supply-well protection area in the north (Ettersberg). Statewide WMS, crop to AOI later.

layers.name: Hydrogeology — upper aquifer
layers.description: Hydrogeological Map of Thuringia 1:200 000 (HÜK200) — uppermost groundwater conductor (Aquifer): rock type, permeability class. Statewide WMS.

layers.name: Hydrogeology — upper aquitard
layers.description: HÜK200 — uppermost low-permeability layer (Aquitard / Grundwasserhemmer). Statewide WMS.

layers.name: Hydrogeology — Cenozoic aquifer
layers.description: HÜK200 — Cenozoic (Känozoische) groundwater conductor: the young unconsolidated aquifers (valley fills, terraces) — relevant along the Ilm valley through Weimar. Statewide WMS.

layers.name: Geological map 1:200 000
layers.description: Geological Overview Map of Thuringia 1:200 000 (GÜK200) — surface bedrock units. Statewide WMS, renders over Weimar. (A 1:25 000 map exists as layer gk25 but has gaps around Weimar.)

layers.name: Nature reserves (NSG)
layers.description: Naturschutzgebiete — the strictest protected-area class. Statewide WMS, crop to AOI later.

layers.name: Landscape protection areas (LSG)
layers.description: Landschaftsschutzgebiete — large-area landscape protection. Statewide WMS.

layers.name: Natura 2000 — bird sanctuaries (SPA)
layers.description: EU-Vogelschutzgebiete (Special Protection Areas). Statewide WMS; an SPA reaches the Weimar area. FFH sites are a separate layer (not wired yet).

layers.name: Bus & tram stops (VMT)
layers.description: 347 bus/tram/rail stops inside the Weimar AOI, from the VMT (Verkehrsverbund Mittelthüringen) GTFS feed. Points with stop name, DHID/IFOPT id, platform, wheelchair-boarding flag. Static GeoJSON via tools/fetch_gtfs_stops.py — re-run to refresh (feed 2026-08-28). Routes/timetables are in the full GTFS, not this layer.

layers.name: Road network (ATKIS)
layers.description: Road segments (Straßensegment) from the ATKIS Basis-DLM, INSPIRE Transport Networks. Full street network incl. minor roads. Statewide WMS.

layers.name: Railway network (ATKIS)
layers.description: Railway links (Eisenbahnverbindung) from the ATKIS Basis-DLM, INSPIRE Transport Networks. Statewide WMS.

layers.name: Railway station areas (ATKIS)
layers.description: Station grounds (Bahnhofsgelände) polygons from the ATKIS Basis-DLM, INSPIRE Transport Networks. Statewide WMS.

layers.name: Classified road network
layers.description: Klassifiziertes Straßennetz (Straßeninformationsbank): Autobahn / Bundes- / Landes- / Kreis- / Gemeindestraße with network nodes and kilometre reference. Statewide WMS.

layers.name: Road network (ATKIS, vector)
layers.description: 8912 road-centreline segments intersecting the Weimar AOI — the real street network (residential streets included, e.g. "Belvederer Allee", "Bahnhofstraße", "Karl-Marx-Straße"), not just the classified skeleton. Fetched from the INSPIRE ATOM feed "TH Verkehrsnetze ATKIS Basis-DLM" (tn-ro:RoadLink, joined to tn-ro:Road for name/classification where grouped) by tools/fetch_weimar_roads_atkis.py — supersedes the first attempt (tools/fetch_weimar_roads.py, STRNETZ_wfs, only 51 classified segments; see DATA_LOG.md for the correction). Attributes: roadLinkId, fictitious, name, nationalRoadCode (A/B/L/K class, ~740 segments), localRoadCode — 4337 segments carry a joined name.

layers.name: Traffic volumes (census 2015)
layers.description: Straßenverkehrszählung 2015 — average daily traffic volumes (DTV) on the classified road network, by count-section. Statewide WMS (also a WFS: STRNETZ_SVZ_wfs). Latest open SVZ for Thuringia.

layers.name: Pedestrian & cycle network (OSM)
layers.description: 7924 OpenStreetMap features for the Weimar AOI: 7667 ways tagged highway=footway/path/pedestrian/steps/cycleway/track (or foot=yes/designated on another road class — sidewalks and shared paths mapped that way) plus 257 highway=crossing points. Separate resource from every official layer in this project — licence ODbL, attribution © OpenStreetMap contributors, not merged with any dl-de/by-2-0 derivative. Fetched via Overpass by tools/fetch_weimar_pedestrian_osm.py. Attributes: highway, name, surface, foot, bicycle, wheelchair, lit, ref, sidewalk, crossing.

layers.name: ATKIS Verkehr — Straßenachsen (street axes)
layers.description: 3414 street centre-line axes intersecting the Weimar admin boundary — this is the transport network. Native ATKIS Basis-DLM object catalogue (ObjektartText=AX_Strassenachse, Objektart 42003), manually downloaded via the geoportal.thueringen.de OpenData Download Client — not the INSPIRE 'Verkehrsnetze' harmonisation used by 'Road network (ATKIS, vector)'. EPSG:25832→4326, clipped to the Weimar admin boundary, cleaned via tools/geojson_clean.py by tools/merge_weimar_atkis_verkehr.py (TASK_13 + TASK_14 merged 7 more manual OpenData Download Client rectangles; dedup by eindeutigerObjektidentifikator; coverage grew from the ~7x7.8 km city centre to ~95% of the municipality). Off by default — one layer per object type, awaiting visual review before deciding what to keep / merge / drop (TASK_07).
